node.statement: Complete raw-call data, without importing a threshold claim. Nodes 1.2-1.4 explicitly supply P_old and P_fresh, with P_old+P_fresh=P_J, all required subordination and complementarity data, v_old when m>1, v_fresh, and their fixed amplification families. For m>1 choose the raw-call target to be A and the literal output to be the sum of the two component maps after the supplied corner-to-A inclusions; record P_old,P_fresh, source C^{m+1}, target-ambient defect epsilon, base scale t_1, no post-helper scale, and candidate d_raw=D_1*t_1. For m=1 choose target A_fresh=S_{P_fresh}, source C^2=C^{m+1}, output v_fresh, target-ambient defect L*epsilon, and candidate d_raw=C_pair*L*epsilon. Together with the Stage-1 tag and supplied input w, these are all fields required by def-maincb-raw-call. The definition explicitly says that the recorded d_raw asserts no inclusion result, so this record exists before the external refinement lemma is applied. No assertion t_1<=e_1 is made in this data-formation step.
